description: The Project Blueprint method (free, no passport needed): six planning stages (concept, features, pages, database, tech_spec, tasks), each with instructions, a JSON Schema and a worked example. You plan with your own model. Buy project-blueprint to get every stage checked (your database schema really runs on PostgreSQL), a task list you tick off, and a plan page for your human. Pass stage to get just one.

passport_token.description: Not needed on this public tool; accepted and ignored.

stage.description: Stage name, in order: concept, features, pages, database, tech_spec, tasks.
